title: Unbelievable do the Math
body: Read teaser for app. It was interesting, thought I might try it. Story is advertised as 171 chapters… a nice read. Opened it up and went to get the next chapter. They wanted 199 coins to unlock it. Let’s do the math. The are 167 chapters left and assuming remaining chapter unlock at same cost ( not a progressive scale ) is 167x199=33,233 coins. Their best deal is 10000 + 4000 bonus for $99. 33233/14000=2.37 or more than $200. I’m in for the entire story for $14.99 over $200.00 NFW
